links.outcome: Trainee AI use in daily work without prior formal AI training
links.effect: Only 10 of 83 respondents reported prior formal AI training; 73% disagreed their curriculum had enough. 30% used AI for diagnosis, 27% for treatment, 28% for teaching.
links.quote: Importantly, trainees reported utilizing AI in daily practice without training.

links.outcome: Trainee AI literacy training gap and desire for formal AI education
links.effect: 84% agreed a need for formal AI training exists; 73% disagreed that their current curriculum contained enough; only 10 had prior formal AI training.
links.quote: Eighty-four percent of trainees agreed with a need for formal AI training, while 73% disagreed that their current curriculum contained enough.

unlisted_practices: Attending physician role modeling of AI use in graduate medical education (reported as low, 11-22%)
Integrating AI curriculum into graduate medical education

screen.reason: The study is a cross-sectional survey examining graduate medical education trainees' perceptions, current use, and formal training needs regarding AI in clinical training and tasks.
